segments.sensitive: Multiple reviewers with sensitive, highly sensitive, or sensitive-combination skin report the scrub does not burn, irritate, or leave redness, several noting it is the only exfoliant they can tolerate on the face, though one sensitive-skin user still had an allergic reaction with swelling and rash.
segments.combination: One reviewer with sensitive combination skin reports a noticeably different skin texture after just one use, with no abrasiveness or dryness.
segments.mature: Reviewers identifying mature skin report the scrub removes daily sunscreen buildup and leaves skin clean and moisturized without harshness.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry or dry-winter skin say the scrub removes flaky, dry skin and leaves the face soft and moisturized rather than tight or stripped.

concerns.aging: Reviewers describing mature skin report a gentle, non-harsh clean with a smooth, glowing result after removing sunscreen or daily buildup.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers say the scrub leaves skin hydrated, plump, or moisturized rather than dry or tight; one reviewer with dry environmental conditions used it to manage flaky skin, and none report increased dryness.
concerns.redness: Reviewers prone to irritation from other scrubs say this one leaves skin without redness or irritation, though one reviewer experienced a rash and swollen eyes lasting several days.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer specifically notes the scrub exfoliates while leaving the skin barrier intact, with skin feeling supple and hydrated afterward; another reports tiny cuts and no smoothing benefit.
concerns.spots: One reviewer credits the scrub with clearing whiteheads and achieving clear skin; another reports a few breakouts the day after use.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer uses it specifically when starting to break out and finds it refreshing and clarifying; a different reviewer reports new breakouts after use.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer notes the scrub reduced pore size and left skin smooth, but oiliness itself is not directly discussed by others.
